description: This file defines the ReminderManager class, which manages scheduling, canceling, rescheduling, and dispatching notifications for reminders in an Android note-taking app. It interacts with AlarmManager, NotificationManager, and repositories for reminders and notes.

classes.name: ReminderManager
classes.description: Manages scheduling, canceling, rescheduling, and notification dispatching for reminders.

methods.name: requestBroadcast
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a reminder broadcast.

methods.name: isReminderSet
methods.description: Checks if a reminder is already scheduled.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a reminder at a specific time.

methods.name: cancelAllRemindersForNote
methods.description: Cancels all reminders associated with a specific note.

methods.name: rescheduleAll
methods.description: Reschedules all reminders, deleting expired ones.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Dispatches a notification when a reminder fires.
